subject: CLAIM shader-coverage-opus: mali_graphics_compiler.c select_mrt_outputs type check (format-aware int/uint outputs for integer MRT targets; not mrt_format_ok)
body: Region: select_mrt_outputs, the 2-line float-type check only, plus one new static mrt_format_integer() right above it. Float-class targets keep the exact current refusal text ('...must be float...', check mrt/integer_output_refused unchanged). Integer Metal formats (13/14/23/24/33/34/53/54/63/64/73/74/91/103/104/113/114/123/124) require a matching uint/int output. No effect until texture-opus adds integer formats to mrt_format_ok (step 2b) - then integer true-MRT compiles (single-target integer outputs already compile today: host probe ivec4 rc0). Codegen of existing pairs unchanged.
